title: Kurukh people - Wikipedia
text: Music and dance Since time immemorial The Oraon people have a rich range of folk songs, dances and tales, [33] as well as traditional musical instruments. Both men and women participate in dances, which are performed at social events and festivals. The Mandar, Nagara and Kartal are the main musical instruments. In Kurukh, song is known as "Dandi".

title: Dravidian peoples - Wikipedia
text: The Dravidian peoples, Dravidian-speakers or Dravidians, are a collection of ethnolinguistic groups native to South Asia who speak Dravidian languages. There are around 250 million native speakers of Dravidian languages. [1]
